title: Elements 55-86: period 6, with the lanthanides
trouble: Rereading feels like knowing; it is not. Recall, then check.

blocks.html: Row six holds gold, platinum, mercury and lead, and the fifteen lanthanides that are tucked below the main table. Every element in this list is in period 6.

How to hold it: This row is long (32 elements), so the chunks matter. Learn the two s-block metals, then the lanthanides in three chunks of five, then the transition metals, then the p-block. A story chain helps with the lanthanides: link each name to the next in one silly scene. Au (aurum), Hg (hydrargyros, liquid silver), Pb (plumbum) and W (wolfram) are the odd symbols to drill.
